## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**

**2. Which sectors are leading?**

Technology showing pockets of strength: NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +7.38% | 1M: +16.40%) ABOVE TREND.

Consumer Staples weak: PM (1W: -6.30% | 1M: -1.86%) BELOW TREND, PEP (1W: -6.57% | 1M: -5.76%) BELOW TREND. Industrials soft: BA (1W: -6.29% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND.

Top 5: MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND; VLO (1W: +13.23% | 1M: +17.93%) ABOVE TREND; PSX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +13.11%) ABOVE TREND; GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND; NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Broad (3 sectors in Top 5), cyclical Energy plus Financials and Tech.

Highest 1W momentum: MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.23% | 1M: +17.93%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +12.64% | 1M: +13.11%) ABOVE TREND, GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND — watch LRCX (1W: +6.12% | 1M: -4.46%) POTENTIAL REVERSAL and IBM (1W: -29.09% | 1M: -21.02%) BELOW TREND for tactical risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology (24 stocks): 1W: +0.09% | 1M: -0.31% — mixed internally with clear leadership but soft breadth overall; NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND, AMAT (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +7.79%) ABOVE TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials (20 stocks): 1W: +0.76% | 1M: +6.83% — broadly constructive; GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +9.87%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +1.08% | 1M: +11.59%) ABOVE TREND — sector contributing to market stability.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare (17 stocks): 1W: -3.40% | 1M: +2.23% — defensive names showing mixed signals; JNJ (1W: -5.01% | 1M: +6.51%) TREND EXHAUSTION, UNH (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +5.44%) TREND EXHAUSTION, LLY (1W: -6.72% | 1M: -0.72%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and selective Financials given current momentum (MPC, VLO, GS) and reduce exposure to structurally weak names showing large downside (IBM, ORCL, LLY, BA). Style: mixed / no clear leadership — be selective amid major divergences between large caps and cyclicals.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +13.23% | 1M: +17.93%) ABOVE TREND, GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: IBM (1W: -29.09% | 1M: -21.02%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -9.33% | 1M: -30.26%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -6.29% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA weekly momentum and any reversal below the recent breakout (hold weekly gains). Monitor GS/JPM for continuation above recent 1M strength as confirmation of Financials leadership. Flag ORCL and IBM breach continuation as triggers to reduce exposure; watch PFE/JNJ price action for follow-through on bullish news.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**

JNJ (+80): Q2 beat and raised guide; JNJ (1W: -5.01% | 1M: +6.51%) TREND EXHAUSTION — news positive but near-term weakness. GS (+60): strong Q2 trading beat; GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND — news confirming price action.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (-80): DOJ antitrust probe; UNH (1W: -0.70% | 1M: +5.44%) TREND EXHAUSTION — headline increases risk despite 1M strength. IBM (-70): worst-day headlines; IBM (1W: -29.09% | 1M: -21.02%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms price collapse. NVDA (-65): headlines on China client losses; NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment divergent from strong price; watch for follow-through. BA (-55): 777X delays; BA (1W: -6.29% | 1M: -2.04%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership. Energy names MPC (1W: +13.92% | 1M: +16.33%) ABOVE TREND, GS (1W: +9.30% | 1M: +10.08%) ABOVE TREND and NVDA (1W: +7.55% | 1M: +3.38%) ABOVE TREND are showing strength. Key risk is major divergence among large caps (GOOGL (1W: -2.05% | 1M: +0.49%) TREND EXHAUSTION; IBM (1W: -29.09% | 1M: -21.02%) BELOW TREND) and mixed sentiment/price signals (PFE/JNJ bullish news vs short-term price weakness).
